---
title: "PGA Tour Putting Stats"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

# Sample dataset of PGA Tour golfers and putts per round
pga_data <- tibble(
  golfer = c("Taylor Montgomery", "Maverick McNealy", "Harry Hall", 
             "Sam Burns", "Denny McCarthy", "Tour Average", "Field Bottom 10%"),
  putts_per_round = c(27.3, 27.5, 27.6, 27.8, 27.8, 28.9, 30.2),
  group = c(rep("Top 10%", 5), "Average", "Bottom 10%")
)

# Create a bar plot using ggplot2
ggplot(pga_data, aes(x = reorder(golfer, putts_per_round), y = putts_per_round, fill = group)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Putts Per Round on the PGA Tour",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Putts Per Round",
    fill = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
